observation.command:
cp /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/xplanbox.conf /tmp/xplanbox.conf.bak
# temporarily comment out catch-all
sed -i 's|^  ProxyPass / http://127.0.0.1:18081/$|#  ProxyPass / http://127.0.0.1:18081/|; s|^  ProxyPassReverse / http://127.0.0.1:18081/$|#  ProxyPassReverse / http://127.0.0.1:18081/|' /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/xplanbox.conf
apache2ctl configtest 2>&1 | tail -1 && apache2ctl -k restart >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
curl -s -o /tmp/o1 -w "no-catchall mapserver: %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:8080/xplan-mapserver?request=GetCapabilities&service=WMS&version=1.1.1"
head -c 120 /tmp/o1
